title: Huber soft-teacher margin regression
formal_object: Fixed train pair design X, teacher margin t, residual r_i=x_i^T w-t_i, Huber delta>0 and anchored ridge.
assumptions: Teacher labels/margins are fixed before fitting; delta and iteration cap selected without test.
Bounded influence concerns residuals at fixed x, not robustness to high-leverage x.
Finite IRLS cannot be called the exact minimizer without actual convergence/residual evidence.

operations.condition: weights computed from current nonzero residual or continuous limit at zero

derivation_steps.justification: Differentiate the two Huber branches; at their join the derivatives agree.
A stationary weighted least-squares equation matches the Huber first-order equation when weights are evaluated at that stationary residual.

derivation_steps.statement: If ||x|| is unbounded, delta||x|| is unbounded; extreme correct teacher margins can be important hard examples.
derivation_steps.justification: The bound isolates residual influence and supplies two separate failure explanations rather than a universal robust-learning claim.

method_expression: At most the declared finite IRLS steps solving the same anchored ridge subproblem; record actual Huber objective, residual/weight diagnostics and solver accuracy at each Local iteration, not a fictitious convergence certificate.
distinguishing_prediction: Benefit requires harmful extreme teacher residuals rather than useful hard labels; saturation counts and native subgroup errors should distinguish the two.
falsifier: Optimized CE KD or simple clipping matches the benefit, or Huber suppresses correct semantic extremes and harms native outcomes.
closest_alternative: Known Huber regression, robust KD, optimized CE/listwise KD and simple target clipping; squared KD alone is not the strongest simple explanation.
decisive_comparison: Same student, teacher, information, data and total fitting cost; predeclare clipping/Huber diagnostics and full three-task results.
legacy_code_audit: Legacy I14 performs capped 12-step IRLS on teacher margins; no convergence or matched CE-KD qualification exists.
review_limit: Convex influence and IRLS fixed-point identity reviewed, no empirical robustness or originality verdict.
